content.title: Risk, Return, and Anomalies in Islamic Equity Markets: A Post-2020 Review
content.abstract: Background: The rapid growth of the Islamic capital market has spurred significant academic interest in developing and validating asset pricing models that adhere to Shariah principles. Traditional models like the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) are often inadequate due to their reliance on interest-based risk-free rates and assumptions that may not hold in Shariah-compliant contexts.
